method: One in-memory mutation at a time. Before: selected existing module suites, including the recorded edit-preview suite correction. After: new module regressions alone. Source hashes and application receipts are required. No static source scan is claimed to see the injected text.
scope: A finite sample across current executable modules, not exhaustive branch coverage or a whole-suite mutation score. See each mutant existingTests list. Reserved modules and declaration/re-export-only files have no rule mutation.
